raw.title: Avoid pinning transitive lockfile entries
raw.body:
This fixes the dependabot PR CI test errors.  As explained by Codex:

-----

What changed:
* Replaced exact transitive lockfile assertions like @emnapi/core@1.11.2 and proxy-agent@8.0.2.
* Kept stable package-lock checks:lockfile version is 3
* root lockfile dependencies match package.json direct runtime dependencies

Reason:
* Dependabot can legitimately change, dedupe, or remove transitive lockfile entries.
* npm ci is already the authoritative check that the lockfile is complete and installable.
* The old test encoded one historical lockfile workaround too literally, so every valid dependency update could fail CI.

Verification:
* npm test -- tests/package/package-lock.test.mjs passed.
* npm test passed: 10 files, 25 tests.
